name: NOAA NCEI Global Forecast System Forecast Archive
publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
onlineWindow: approximately the most recent two years on NCEI; the 2025 object set was verified in NOAA's public noaa-gfs-bdp-pds archive

verifiedArchiveAccess.provider: NOAA Big Data Program AWS Open Data
verifiedArchiveAccess.pointSelection: nearest 0.5-degree grid point to the verified site centroid

pairingResolutionPolicy.resampling: linear interpolation of U/V components between adjacent valid times; issue time remains the latest issue used and must precede the target

pairingRules: Preserve the model cycle as nwp_issue_time.
Derive nwp_valid_time from model cycle plus forecast hour.
Use only cycles available before the target observation time.
Use byte-range extraction for the selected GRIB messages and decode the nearest verified wind-farm grid point.
Do not substitute GFS analysis, ERA5, or WFDE5 for historical issued forecasts.
